reply_intent.description: Classify a reply to a cold outreach email.
reply_intent.use_case: Outbound sales tooling - triage replies after a people-finder campaign

question.instructions: Classify the intent of this reply to a sales outreach email.

criteria.interested: Positive intent; wants a call, a demo, materials or a trial (even if they also ask questions).
criteria.not_now: Open to it, but explicitly defers to a later time.
criteria.not_interested: Declines without asking to stop all contact.
criteria.wrong_person: Says they are not the right contact, redirects to someone else, or has left the company.
criteria.unsubscribe: Explicitly asks to stop receiving emails.
criteria.out_of_office: Automated absence reply from someone who will return.
criteria.question: Neutral; asks for information before showing any interest or disinterest.
